title: with no journal the residue scan must not claim a clean machine (exit 1, attribution unavailable)
why: Without a journal nothing on this machine can be attributed to this tool, so 'nothing of ours was ever installed here' is not a proven fact. The tool must say so: exit 1, attribution=unavailable with reasonKey journal_absent_cannot_attribute, and the probes it cannot answer (state directory, wildcard listener, collector delta) must be unknown rather than pass. Only the process-memory cordis item is exempt.
inject: an empty fixture (no journal, no observations) with -CheckOnly -AsJson
expectSummary: exit 1, attribution=unavailable, residue unknown (not pass), cordis unknown but exempt, nothing written
